We don't have those. We cannot proceed. But maybe we can just compute flight cost and provide estimate. The user didn't ask to actually book. They want to check different options. So we can compute flight cost. We need to get list of airports. Then compute flight cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount. But we need to know the cost of insurance? Not asked. So just flight cost.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then provide estimate. Let's do that.
